A05J-37.what: General question with a domestic and an overseas rule; the model answered only the domestic office and cited one record.

A05J-63.what: Correct answer: 'cơ quan tuyển dụng phải báo cáo … trong vòng 15 ngày' (the employer reports within 15 days). During review the alternatives 'cơquantuyểndụng'/'bêntuyểndụng' were removed because they also occur in the question, so the correct wording no longer satisfies the mention group.
A05J-63.root_cause: Over-tightened required_mentions; the role-reversal pattern added at the same time was the right safeguard. The frozen result stands.
